name: 2,088-Structure Benchmark
description: This dataset contains the data used in the study entitled " Beyond Random Splits: A 2,088-Structure Benchmark and a Three-Level Validation Ladder for Aquatic Acute Toxicity Quantitative Structure–Activity Relationship Models ". The dataset includes the aquatic acute toxicity data, chemical identifiers and physicochemical information used for data analysis and QSAR modelling, as well as the corresponding QSAR prediction results. The dataset is provided to support the reproducibility and transparency of the analyses reported in the associated manuscript. The data are organized according to the variables and procedures described in the manuscript. For further details regarding data collection, preprocessing, modelling procedures and data interpretation, please refer to the associated research article.
